N-cone-definition.objects: Real Banach A, cone and its gauge.
N-cone-definition.domain: All z in cone and all nonnegative real c.
N-cone-definition.fixed_and_variable: A and cone fixed; z and c vary.
N-cone-definition.hypotheses: Nonnegative scaling, definiteness and positive degree-one homogeneity.
N-cone-definition.equations: Gauge axioms are displayed and the embedding norm bound is explicit.
N-cone-definition.quantifiers: One embedding constant for all z; every gauge-bounded sequence.
N-cone-definition.conclusion: Defines continuous and compact cone embeddings without additivity.
N-cone-definition.local_definitions: Explains that subtraction and triangle inequality are not required.

scope.evidence_basis: Actual original-source comparison and local derivation reread: Read source equation (1.1) and the gauge axioms on pp. 2--3. Positive homogeneity and definiteness do not give addition, subtraction or a triangle inequality. Compact gauge balls are understood in ambient A, without claiming a limit remains in the cone.
